column3: Private home prices rose 1.4% in 3Q 2026, and more than 32,000 new units could go on sale within two years. Read it before you buy or sell a home.
Since 30 Oct 2026, a loan for an individual-owned private hire car is capped at 60% or 70% of the price and at 7 years. Check this before you buy a car to drive for hire.
Employment grew by 27,700 in 3Q 2026, but retrenchments edged up in outward-oriented sectors. Check your own sector in the release before a job move.
From 1 Dec 2026, public hospitals offer subsidised genetic tests for hereditary breast and ovarian cancer, payable by MediSave. Ask your doctor if a close relative had either cancer.
Real median income grew 1.3% a year in 2019 to 2025, down from 3.4% in 2015 to 2019. Manufacturing output grew 5.0% a year while its resident jobs fell 1.3% a year.
An insurer needs no doctor's sign-off to refuse an Integrated Shield Plan claim. Take a disputed claim to FIDReC.
IMDA is studying how AI changes entry-level tech hiring. Students in tech courses can look at Bridge2Tech for work experience.
Net rental income declared for 2026: $1.7 billion by owners of two homes, $0.9 billion by owners of three or four, and $0.4 billion by owners of five or more.
Singapore has no plans to join the OECD scheme that shares property ownership data between tax authorities.
$300 in CDC Vouchers comes in January 2027 and Assurance Package cash in December 2026. A third of the June 2026 vouchers were unspent at end-September, so check yours.
The $10 cap on treatment for haze-related conditions ends on 12 Nov 2026.
